what_it_does: sets timestep and constructs all benchmark objects
outputs: Pin_KinDyn; DataBus; WBC_priority; GaitScheduler; PVT_Ctr; FootPlacement; JoyStickInterpreter; DataLogger
notes: No MuJoCo model, no viewer, no XML scene loaded

what_it_does: builds free-flyer and fixed-base Pinocchio models and resolves key joint ids
outputs: model_nv; Jacobian buffers; dynamic buffers; motor limits
notes: uses pinocchio::JointModelFreeFlyer for the floating-base model

what_it_does: allocates shared state vectors and default motion state
notes: model_nv-6 motor joints; q has model_nv+1 because free-flyer quaternion adds one coordinate

what_it_does: constructs hierarchical WBC tasks and qpOASES QProblem
outputs: walk and stand priority task trees; QP buffers
notes: stand task order used in this benchmark unless motionState changes

what_it_does: initializes swing time and gait state
notes: wbc_speed_test only calls step on LoopCount<1

what_it_does: loads joint PD, torque, velocity, position, gear and LPF parameters
outputs: PVT gains and limits for 31 motor joints
notes: later main overrides selected ankle/knee gains each loop

what_it_does: computes initial desired leg/hand joint pose and gives WBC initial q
inputs: desired foot and hand poses in body frame
notes: used as WBC initialization/reference context, not directly logged

what_it_does: registers datalog column blocks and writes matlabReadDataScript.txt
notes: column ranges confirmed by runtime_record/matlabReadDataScript.txt

what_it_does: defines fixed motor position/velocity samples and LoopNum
notes: sample state is replayed each iteration rather than simulated forward

what_it_does: loads motor/base/force sample values and converts them into q,dq
inputs: motors_pos_cur; motors_vel_cur; rpy; basePos; base velocities/accelerations
notes: fL/fR are zero in this benchmark

what_it_does: updates kinematics, Jacobians, frame positions and dynamics terms
notes: uses forwardKinematics, Jacobians, CRBA, Minv, Coriolis, gravity, centroidal quantities

what_it_does: updates desired base command from ramped joystick-like velocity
inputs: current base x/y/yaw for initialization; desired vx/wz parameters
notes: lines 140-141 set desired vx to zero after the earlier xv_des branch, so this benchmark is effectively stationary command

what_it_does: reads contact/dynamics info and writes gait phase/contact state
notes: step() runs only when LoopCount<1; with motionState Stand it keeps phi=0 and legState DSt

what_it_does: computes swing foot desired position from gait phase and velocity command
notes: in Stand/DSt mode some legState branches are not selected; output should be treated as benchmark-specific

what_it_does: sets feed-forward contact wrench and desired base q/dq/ddq
inputs: Fr_ff zeros then [0,0,370,0,0,0,0,0,370,0,0,0]; jsInterp command; current dq
outputs: RobotState.Fr_ff; des_delta_q; des_dq; des_ddq; base_rpy_des; base_pos_des
notes: math logic is unchanged; values are hard-coded for speed test

what_it_does: runs hierarchical kinematic task solve then contact-force/torque QP
inputs: Jacobian/dynamics terms; desired base/foot targets; contact state; Fr_ff; q,dq
notes: computeDdq uses PriorityTasks; computeTau solves a QP with QP_nv=18 and QP_nc=22

what_it_does: propagates prioritized tasks through null-space projections
notes: called by WBC_priority::computeDdq for Stand or Walk task tree

what_it_does: builds QP constraints for floating-base dynamics and contact wrench limits
notes: stdout does not print qpStatus; datalog does not record WBC outputs in this demo

what_it_does: computes joint output torques from desired/current joint position and velocity plus feed-forward torque
notes: main's direct conversion from WBC outputs to motor desired commands is commented out, so PVT mostly uses default zero desired commands in this benchmark

what_it_does: measures elapsed time since previous start timestamp
notes: because start=end occurs before logger/printf, next loop includes previous logger/printf overhead

what_it_does: writes one comma-separated datalog row
notes: DataLogger also creates matlabReadDataScript.txt during schema registration

what_it_does: prints one execution time line per loop
notes: the final extra stdout line is printed after the loop

what_it_does: prints final datalog hint
outputs: loop time recorded to the last column of record/datalog.log
notes: explains the 10001st stdout line
